theorem: Clinical Case Study: Managing a Patient with Hypertension
description: A nursing case study on assessing and managing hypertension. Hahn Tran is a 53-year-old client who presents to her health care provider’s office with reports of a headache and dizziness. When questioned, she describes her headache as throbbing and that it is worse in the morning when she awakens. She is unable to identify any triggers for the headaches but states they are relieved with acetaminophen. Explain the patient's risk factors (diet, smoking, diabetes, hyperlipidemia, sedentary lifestyle), how these contribute to high blood pressure, what the vital signs and history indicate, and the nursing assessment and patient-education priorities.
